title: Beware of spyware: Access Now urges pension funds to scrutinize investments for spyware exposure
content: On September 28, 2026, Access Now wrote to four pension funds — Los Angeles County Employees Retirement Association, Houston Firefighters’ Relief and Retirement Fund, New Mexico Educational Retirement Board, and  Hampshire Pension Fund — regarding their investment in AE Industrial Partners (AEI). AEI purchased spyware technology vendor Paragon Solutions in 2024 and merged the company with its holding company REDLattice. The letters urge pension fund managers to use their leverage with AEI to ensure the fund “provide[s] remedy where warranted, and implement robust safeguards” to prevent any contribution to human rights breaches.
